ShortDescription.Value: Better Transit Boarding. Late solo passengers stop holding up vehicles, and cims may start running earlier to catch their bus, tram, or train.

Publish.LongDescription:
### Better public transit boarding
The game does not end boarding based on departure time, but rather waits for cims assigned to the vehicle (even if the cim is still far away). This leads to stuck transit vehicles. The game has a fallback for stuck transit and releases them if it's ~10 minutes past scheduled departure time.
#### Better Boarding helps before that by reducing late-passenger delays to keep things smooth and on time.
- Improve traffic, increase transit usage, reduce bunching of vehicles. - The larger your city, the more this mod will help. - ✅ Speeds up public transit boarding/loading with simple sliders. - ✅ Lets late solo cims miss a vehicle (if it's after departure time) so others are not held up. - ✅ Late cims can also start running sooner so they have a chance to catch their ride (bus + tram + train). - ✅ Adds compact Status info in Options menu and a detailed [Stats to Log] report.
### Skip Late Passengers - ✅ When **Skip Late Passengers** is enabled, late solo cims who are still **not ready** even after **departure time** can miss that vehicle instead of making everyone wait. - The cim is not deleted and the game can naturally reassign them.
### Cims Run sooner 🏃‍➡️🏃‍♀️‍➡️🏃‍♂️‍➡️ 🚍 Bus + Tram (Train support is COMING SOON)
- ✅ When **Cims Run Sooner** is ON, the assigned but late passengers can start running a little sooner. - Vanilla starts cims running at departure time, which can be too late to help if they are not already at the stop/station. - Like real life, people start running from a block away, not just at the stop. - It reduces how many cims need to be reassigned later. Works for bus, tram, and train; does not change departure time, force boarding, or teleport citizens.
### Status report included After the city runs a bit, check the Options menu to see current status. - *Skipped* shows how many late solo passengers have been skipped today (so they do not hold up transit). - Example usage: Worst stop shows 10+ minutes, check it for traffic, bad placement, not enough vehicles, or replace the stop. - This is a one-shot button that does not run in the city per-frame, so no real performance impact. - When checking things, I like to click the Stats button every ~20+ min, then compare the report later to see where the worst stops are and more (Scene Explorer mod helps locate the Entity ID numbers). - Use [Stats to Log] button for more detailed snapshot data than what is shown in Options menu.
### Notes - Important Compatibility: conflicts possible with mods that change boarding, like All-Aboard - Only Choose One. Some players report no issues with Smart Transportation + Better Boarding together. - Mod is intended to be a lighter, safer alternative than replacing the game's whole transport system files approach. - This mod works nicely with [All Transit + Trucks](https://mods.paradoxplaza.com/mods/138390/Windows) to solve many transit issues. - Future: Groups/families traveling together are left to vanilla methods so they are not split up (they are few in number and could still cause delays, more research needed for groups). - Safe to remove anytime. No Harmony patches; lightweight design for low overhead.
### Support and feedback - Support by clicking Like 👍 (top right); helps people know about the mod. No donations requested. - Feedback on: Github, Discord links (buttons on the right). PRs welcome.
